units.source_text: 很快地，这件事博得了人们的好评。

en.t: Before long, this won people's approval.

units.source_text: 幼年时代，我在应邀前来我家的客人面前，或是到母亲应邀前往的各人家里去时，不知玩了多少次这种象征母爱的游戏。

en.t: In my childhood, whether in front of guests who had been invited to our home, or when I went with my mother to the homes where she had been invited, I played this game symbolizing maternal love countless times.

units.source_text: 我不仅玩纸牌，还渐渐表现出惊人的神童般的天才。

en.t: I did not merely play cards; little by little, I also began to display the astonishing talent of a prodigy.
